sentences.chinese: 声母是音节的开头辅音。
sentences.pinyin: Shēng mǔ shì yīn jié de kāi tóu fǔ yīn.
sentences.translation: Initials are the starting consonants of syllables.
sentences.usage: Explaining the role of initials in Mandarin syllables.

sentences.chinese: 韵母是音节的元音或元音组合。
sentences.pinyin: Yùn mǔ shì yīn jié de yuán yīn huò yuán yīn zǔ hé.
sentences.translation: Finals are the vowels or vowel combinations in syllables.
sentences.usage: Describing the structure of Mandarin finals.

sentences.chinese: 零声母表示音节没有辅音开头。
sentences.pinyin: Líng shēng mǔ biǎo shì yīn jié méi yǒu fǔ yīn kāi tóu.
sentences.translation: Zero initial indicates a syllable with no starting consonant.
sentences.usage: Explaining syllables starting with vowels only.

sentences.chinese: 韵母可以是单韵母或复韵母。
sentences.pinyin: Yùn mǔ kě yǐ shì dān yùn mǔ huò fù yùn mǔ.
sentences.translation: Finals can be simple or compound vowels.

sentences.chinese: 鼻韵母包含鼻辅音结尾，如an、en。
sentences.pinyin: Bí yùn mǔ bāo hán bí fǔ yīn jié wěi, rú an, en.
sentences.translation: Nasal finals end with nasal consonants, e.g., an, en.

sentences.pinyin: I, u, ü shì fù yùn mǔ de cháng jiàn chéng fèn.
sentences.translation: i, u, ü are common components of compound finals.
sentences.usage: Highlighting common elements in compound finals.

sentences.pinyin: Ü zhǐ néng yǔ j, q, x, y děng shēng mǔ lián yòng.
sentences.translation: ü can only combine with certain initials like j, q, x, y.
sentences.usage: Special rule for the vowel ü.

sentences.chinese: 声韵配合规则决定拼音的结构。
sentences.pinyin: Shēng yùn pèi hé guī zé jué dìng pīn yīn de jié gòu.
sentences.translation: Initial-final compatibility rules determine pinyin structure.

sentences.chinese: 轻声字没有声调，如“的”、“了”。
sentences.pinyin: Qīng shēng zì méi yǒu shēng diào, rú “de”, “le”.
sentences.translation: Light tones have no pitch, e.g., “de”, “le”.
